items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: I did a show called The Tonight Show, which you know, with Steve Allen.

ctx.x: That was in the late fifties and sixties.
Well, it was just after that. I did a show called The Tonight Show, which you know, with Steve

Allen. Now, George Wein, a very interesting thing, had not hired me that year for the Newport Jazz Festival. I did 14 Newport Jazz Festivals, 14 years. I was in four riots in those years, and now he had not hired me for the Newport Festival this particular year, but I did the Steve Allen Show and he saw it, and he called me that night as soon as I came off the show -- it was live -- and he said I want you to come over to Newport tomorrow and do the show and I laughed and I thought, oh, dear, I have to be on a…
